topic: Conservation is not a welfare outcome
detail: No policy-specific causal mortality, injury or suffering estimate is supported by this legal chronology.
neededData: Species and site exposure, hazards, enforcement, prevention behavior and measured outcomes with a credible counterfactual.
impact: No lives-saved total, welfare effect size or presidential ranking.

detail: ESA status was checked against the agency's current rule page; MBTA implementation is directly corroborated through May 2026. A full court-docket audit through October 19 was not completed.
neededData: Current dockets and any later injunctions, stays, appeals, rules or memoranda.
impact: Published effective dates are reported with a status-completeness caveat.

detail: Secondary reports describe September 2026 take guidance; its primary text was not retrieved in this bounded review and its specific instructions are excluded.
neededData: Signed FWS and NMFS guidance, implementation records and judicial review.
impact: Do not infer from the regulatory rescission that every accidental killing or habitat impact is exempt.

detail: Direct older DOI links for M-37041 and M-37050 returned 404. Their history is documented using the retrieved court opinion and later primary agency records.
neededData: Archived signed opinions for a complete documentary archive.
impact: January 2017 is retained at month precision, consistent with the retrieved court record.

detail: No harmonized animal-outcome panel with defensible treatment and comparison groups was assembled.
neededData: Facility/animal-level longitudinal outcomes, stable reporting and exposure timing; appropriate comparisons.
impact: No national suffering reduction or overall presidential ranking is estimated.

detail: Historical staffing observations are partial. Comparable welfare-specific budgets and inflation series are not yet assembled.
neededData: Actual obligations and welfare-specific FTE by fiscal year; CPI or agency-appropriate deflator and consistent activity boundaries.
impact: No nominal-dollar or inflation-adjusted administration ranking.

detail: General coverage increases are documented; a constant cruelty-reporting agency panel is not validated.
neededData: Agency-month participation and offense-level completeness; local coding transitions and covered populations.
impact: Raw national cruelty counts are excluded from trend claims.

detail: The Grandin audit survey contains direct stunning/handling measures but no federal-policy comparison group.
neededData: Comparable plant outcomes before/after federal implementation, private audit histories, exposure and matched controls.
impact: Observed private audit outcomes cannot be assigned to Clinton or later presidents.

detail: Targeted searches for evaluations of the 1999 depiction law, 2007/2008 fighting laws, 2010 video law, 2014 attendance provision, 2018 territorial expansion, and the animal PACT Act did not identify a credible national causal estimate. This is a search result, not proof no study exists.
neededData: Repeatable measures of harm/prevalence, enforcement intensity, controls/counterfactual design, displacement and reporting changes.
impact: Do not claim the laws reduced cruelty by a measured amount, or infer ineffectiveness from missing evaluations.

detail: Selected DOJ releases and court opinions are not a census. Cases, defendants, charges, seizures, and sentences are different units; multi-statute prosecutions complicate attribution.
neededData: Deduplicated docket-linked national data by statute/subsection, filing and disposition dates, dismissals, convictions, and outcomes.
impact: No annual prosecution/conviction chart or presidential ranking can be built from these selected records.

detail: Research cutoff is October 19, 2026. Official Code text retrieved for §§48,49 and 7 USC2156 states currency through October 9, 2026. Latest selected agency report is October 15, 2026; this is not complete-year coverage.
neededData: Refresh Code and any intervening session laws and court decisions after October 9; obtain full-year 2026 data when published.
impact: Describe status as verified through source currency; avoid claiming complete 2026 legal or enforcement coverage.

detail: Gray release reports 14 dogs seized but no verified rehabilitation, adoption, euthanasia, or long-term welfare follow-up. Other selected records have incomplete victim counts.
neededData: Court forfeiture orders, shelter intake/disposition and veterinary follow-up linked to each case.
impact: Seizure is an intervention measure; it cannot be converted into animals saved or suffering avoided.

detail: §48 video offenses predate PACT. Herrera's 2023 video case illustrates implementation of the current statute but does not isolate what the 2019 conduct offense newly enabled.
neededData: Charging instruments, judgments, offense subsections and legal counterfactual analysis.
impact: Do not credit every post-2019 cruelty or video prosecution to the PACT expansion.

detail: Legacy uscode.house.gov view.xhtml endpoints returned page-not-found/maintenance; CDN requests sometimes timed out. New /us/usc/119-121/ routes resolved current Code. Original Supreme Court slip-opinion link failed; official GovInfo U.S. Reports version was used.
neededData: Archive retrieved documents and hashes; refresh working endpoints. Obtain sentencing judgments for agency-only case records.
impact: Current source links are recorded; primary legal opinions are available, but case releases remain agency claims rather than independent case audits.

detail: Inspections target selected shows and entries; repeat horses and overlapping DQP/APHIS groups are not resolved. A rise in detections can reflect targeting or protocol changes.
neededData: Event-, entry- and horse-level linked data, selection probabilities, consistent diagnostics and a comparison group.
impact: HPA rates describe recorded detection, not national soring prevalence or causal presidential performance.

detail: The 2024 rule includes VMO referrals to DQPs; event-activity reports use narrower reporting. The two-veterinarian confirmation requirement ended in 2021.
neededData: A reconciliation crosswalk across annual event reports, referrals, case dispositions and diagnostic protocols.
impact: Do not splice incompatible reports or attribute the 2021 rise wholly to changing horse welfare.

topic: AWA data quality and changing operations
detail: OIG documented unreliable ACIS queries, manual reports and complaint-follow-up weaknesses. eFile replaced ACIS in 2020; pandemic and virtual inspections changed surveillance.
neededData: Validated entity identifiers, unique-facility coverage, standardized inspection types and animal-exposure denominators.
impact: Inspection and enforcement trends are implementation evidence with structural breaks.

detail: Budget prefaces explicitly specify fiscal years unless otherwise noted. CRS separately reports 254 cases/205 warnings for 2022 versus budget FY2022 counts of 262/204; the source discrepancy is unresolved.
neededData: A versioned APHIS reconciliation of CRS, budget, impact-report and IES figures.
impact: Use the verified fiscal budget series consistently; do not substitute unreconciled CRS figures.

detail: Official quarterly-workbook catalog was identified, but direct FSIS page retrieval returned access failure and no workbooks were extracted.
neededData: Downloadable quarterly humane-handling tasks, NRs, HATS hours and egregious-event data with matching definitions.
impact: No claim of complete annual FY2021–FY2025 FSIS enforcement trends; historical GAO and 2018–2020 letters are the verified evidence.

detail: No retrieved causal national evaluation isolates the 2013 pet-sales, 2020 dog-care, downer-cattle, veal or organic standards from inspection intensity, private audits, market change and other laws.
neededData: Animal-level health/behavior/injury outcomes, exposure populations, adoption dates and credible comparison groups.
impact: Legal scope and implementation cannot be translated into numbers of animals helped or net presidential scores.

detail: Latest annual APHIS enforcement output is FY2025. Comparable HPA sore-finding series ends FY2023; newer event reports through FY2025 use different columns and the FY2025 snapshot predates fiscal year-end. Organic/HPA transitions extend beyond cutoff.
neededData: Final FY2026 reports, subsequent HPA effective-date records and post-compliance organic audits.
impact: Do not imply complete 2026 coverage or realized benefits from future effective dates.

detail: Six selected trial plants reported task-level humane-handling data with no contemporaneous comparison group. The latest verified implementation update is August 5, 2026; an October search identified no later final rule.
neededData: Plant-level exposure, line speeds, observed handling outcomes, comparable controls and latest docket disposition.
impact: 11/25,821 is an agency verification-task ratio, not a pig-abuse rate or proof of safety; proposed changes remain distinct from implemented rules.

detail: The public-search restoration is verified but completeness and historical redaction are not independently audited here.
neededData: Archived portal snapshots, completeness audit and research linking access to corrective action.
impact: Transparency is a plausible mechanism, not a measured welfare gain.

detail: The five-year ARS series reports registered facilities and annual inspection visits; the facility portfolio changes and does not represent all research establishments.
neededData: Facility-level panel and standardized incident severities.
impact: Visits per facility are workload; detected noncompliance fractions are neither animal-harm rates nor generalizable nationally.

detail: No complete comparable annual count of all U.S. laboratory animals was verified in this review; APHIS excludes several major populations and NIH's October 2026 expansion remains a proposal.
neededData: Annual institution/species counts with stable definitions, duplicates removed and noncovered animals included.
impact: No national 'animals saved' estimate or cross-administration causal ranking.

detail: Roadmaps, awards, draft guidance, future-effective rules and projected savings do not establish realized animal reductions.
neededData: Sponsor and project uptake; protocol-level replacement and animal counts; comparison group and medical safety outcomes.
impact: Classify as implementation, not proven suffering reduction.

detail: Bird regulation phased in 2023–24; summaries split Other Animals into bird/farm/mammal groups in 2024. Named-species coverage is more stable than all-animal totals, but facility reporting still varies.
neededData: Facility-level balanced panel, amendments and species/category crosswalk.
impact: Do not infer welfare gains from changes in total research counts.

detail: Latest retrieved NOAA report covers 2023. Earlier and later reports disagree on 2021 export unit value ($5,133 versus $6,102 per metric ton); that price is excluded.
neededData: Reconciled customs microdata, illegal trade, species-specific catch and mortality, post-2023 records.
impact: Zero declared fin trade is not zero shark deaths; no causal impact size was established in this review.

detail: This review located official implementation guidance but no verified national registration or post-enactment welfare/incident series.
neededData: Registrations, transfers, breeding, public-contact incidents, welfare inspections and enforcement outcomes.
impact: Legal and implementation confidence exceeds outcome confidence.

detail: October 16, 2026 DOI announcement verified; final FR document 2026-21299 retrieval failed. Announcement specifies October 19 publication and effectiveness 30 days later.
neededData: Published final text, later effective-date notices and litigation status, then harvest/wounding data.
impact: Describe finalized/announced replacement, not already-effective rule; no forecast counted as observed.

detail: GAO provides a 2016 census, current sanctuary history supplies implementation, and a 2023 paper analyzes 2005 habitat use. None isolates the causal welfare effect of the 2015 policy.
neededData: Individual transfer, survival, morbidity and behavioral-welfare panel with comparable baseline.
impact: Separate retirement eligibility, relocation and experienced welfare.

detail: Ivory/live-import rules have conservation mechanisms but no retrieved causal estimate of individual suffering reduction attributable to U.S. action alone.
neededData: Causal trade/poaching study with global policy controls and welfare endpoints.
impact: Do not equate conservation status or population recovery with measured suffering reduction.

topic: Conflicting NOAA records for 2019 shark-fin imports
detail: 2020 Atlantic HMS SAFE, published March 2021, Table 8.30, printed p. 211 (PDF p. 234), records preliminary 2019 imports of 1 metric ton total: dried 0, fresh 1, frozen 0 (rw-s-shark-safe2020). The 2024 Shark Finning Report p. 8 states no imports since 2019 (rw-s-shark-report), which may mean after 2019 or reflect revisions. The reason is unverified. The 2019 observation is marked missing/disputed with value null; no source value is silently selected.
neededData: Reconcile customs product codes, raw trade records, revision history and NOAA explanation of the 2019 boundary year.
impact: Exclude 2019 from numeric charts and before/after calculations pending reconciliation; retain the documented conflict. The explicit 2023 zero-export observation remains supported.
